problem: Heavy self-hosted proofs can rebuild unchanged native dependencies or rerun unchanged runtime proof after documentation, Python, asset or proof-orchestration edits, wasting runner time and increasing machine load.
invariant: Separate STATIC, RUNTIME and COMPILE evidence. Hash binary-contract inputs into a compile fingerprint and runtime/proof-contract inputs into a proof fingerprint. Reuse binaries only when the compile fingerprint, installed engine identity and expected binaries match a previously green state. Reuse runtime proof only when the proof fingerprint also matches, while emitting fresh exact-revision equivalence evidence. Missing, malformed or drifting evidence fails closed. Persist only an explicit allow-list of build outputs/state across revisions, and invalidate the previous mutable proof lease before COMPILE or RUNTIME begins.
evidence: YACS PR #288 proved compile-fingerprint reuse for the Passo Giau M3 PCGEx lane
YACS Issue #289 generalizes the pattern to normal code-only Unreal CI
do_not_copy: Passo Giau paths, camera coordinates or proof variant names
failure_behavior: Unknown runtime-sensitive inputs force COMPILE. Missing or malformed state, engine drift, compile-fingerprint mismatch or missing expected binaries forces build/proof validation. A proof-fingerprint-only mismatch permits RUNTIME with verified binaries but never skips Automation. STATIC is allowed only after exact-head checkout plus full compile/proof equivalence checks. A mutable run invalidates the relevant prior green state before execution, so cancellation or failure cannot leave a reusable stamp.
